items.title: The delta-invariant at a point is unchanged by extension of the base field under the geometric normality hypotheses
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades the comparison of delta-invariants across a base field extension from an inequality to an equality, assuming assumptions (a), (b), (c) of the geometrically-normal-in-codimension-1 criterion for x in X together with dim(O_{Y,y}) = 1. The proof again sets A and B equal to the two local rings and uses the criterion to get that A is geometrically reduced, hence B is a localization of A tensor_k K; the improvement over the inequality version is that A' tensor_k K is now normal by the same criterion, which lets the pre-delta construction be matched on both sides so that the two lengths agree (proof lines 8535-8561). H2: the use of normality of the base change of A' to make the comparison two-sided is the substance.
